products.name: Workday AI
products.note: HR and finance AI; skills-based talent; predictive analytics; sensitive HR data exposure

profile_text.body:
Workday is a public company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Pleasanton, CA, USA. It trades under the ticker WDAY and reported revenue of 9552000000 USD in its most recent 10-K, for the period ending 2026-01-31. On its own site the company describes itself as an enterprise AI platform for HR, finance, and IT, and says its AI lets customers activate teams of specialized agents to perform key processes across those areas. It also markets Sana and agentic AI, and frames its pitch around turning AI into ROI faster.

The site's product material centers on Workday AI, which the company presents as HR and finance AI with skills-based talent and predictive analytics. The site emphasizes agents that can act rather than just assist, able to find, build, act, and automate. The company's own framing stresses trust, agility, and data readiness.

Court records list several suits naming Workday, Inc., including Meckfessel Poletti v. Workday, Inc. and a related (PS) Meckfessel Poletti v. Workday, Inc. in the District Court, E.D. California, Williams v. Workday, Inc. in the District Court, N.D. Georgia, Elias v. Workday, Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California, Noriega (PS) v. Workday, Inc. and Doe (PS) v. Workday, Inc. in the District Court, D. Colorado, Hill v. Workday, Inc. in the District Court, D. Maryland and the District Court, E.D. Virginia, and a second Meckfessel Poletti v. Workday, Inc. entry in the E.D. California court. A law exposure record for California lists a count of 281.
